fullPassage: The idea of music direction, in the sense of someone shaping and leading a musical performance, goes back to the beginnings of music. Even the gamelans of ancient Indonesia had leaders who would signal to the group changes of meter and tempo, beginnings and endings, and transitions from piece to piece. Yet listening audiences are not always essential for a performance to be meaningful, and for good aesthetic reason. They need not be aware to fulfill their experience; indeed, the unnecessarily conspicuous presence of a musical leader will detract from it. An audience is better off, for the most part, taking in the whole of a stage work rather than being party to the techniques that go into realizing it. This is not to say that when an orchestra plays alone the audience members' eyes are not fixed on the conductor for the majority of the time; they probably are. When music is accompanying something happening on stage, however, all eyes turn to the stage, and so do everyone's ears, too (including the music director's).

questions.passage: The idea of music direction, in the sense of someone shaping and leading a musical performance, goes back to the beginnings of music. Even the gamelans of ancient Indonesia had leaders who would signal to the group changes of meter and tempo, beginnings and endings, and transitions from piece to piece. Yet listening audiences are not always essential for a performance to be meaningful, and for good aesthetic reason. They need not be aware to fulfill their experience; indeed, the unnecessarily conspicuous presence of a musical leader will detract from it. An audience is better off, for the most part, <u>taking in the whole of a stage work rather than being party to the techniques that go into realizing it</u>. This is not to say that when an orchestra plays alone the audience members' eyes are not fixed on the conductor for the majority of the time; they probably are. When music is accompanying something happening on stage, however, all eyes turn to the stage, and so do everyone's ears, too (including the music director's).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 관객은 기법보다 전체를 감상하는 것이 낫다
det.analysis:
❌ ① 관객이 직접 공연에 참여하는 것이 가장 좋다: 참여가 아닌 감상
❌ ② 무대 뒤의 기술적 과정을 이해해야 한다: 이해가 아닌 거리두기
✅ ③ 관객은 공연의 기술적 세부 사항보다 전체적인 경험에 집중하는 것이 낫다: 원문의 핵심 ← 정답
❌ ④ 예술적 재능이 없으면 공연을 즐길 수 없다: 재능 언급 없음
det.tip: taking in the whole = 전체적 경험. being party to techniques = 기술적 세부. 전자가 나음

ch: 관객이 직접 공연에 참여하는 것이 진정한 음악 경험이다.

questions.stem: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은? 주어진 문장: The idea of music direction, in the sense of someone shaping and leading a musical performance, goes back to the beginnings of music. (A) They need not be aware to fulfill their experience; indeed, the unnecessarily conspicuous presence of a musical leader will detract from it. (B) Even the gamelans of ancient Indonesia had leaders who would signal to the group changes of meter and tempo, beginnings and endings, and transitions from piece to piece. Yet listening audiences are not always essential for a performance to be meaningful, and for good aesthetic reason. (C) An audience is better off, for the most part, taking in the whole of a stage work rather than being party to the techniques that go into realizing it.

det.korean: 주어진 문장 → (B) 가믈란 예시 + 관객 필수성 → (A) 인식 불필요 + 존재감 해로움 → (C) 전체 감상이 나음
det.analysis:
✅ ① (B)-(A)-(C): 주어진 문장(음악 지휘 개념) → (B) 가믈란 예시 + 관객 불필수 → (A) They(=audiences)로 연결 + 존재감이 해로움 → (C) 전체 감상이 기법보다 나음 ← 정답
❌ ② (A)-(B)-(C): They의 지시 대상이 없음
❌ ③ (C)-(B)-(A): 논리적 흐름 불일치
❌ ④ (B)-(C)-(A): A의 They가 C가 아닌 B의 audiences를 받아야 함
det.tip: 주어진 문장 → 역사적 예시(B) → 관객 역할 부연(A) → 결론(C)
